newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for May 22.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for May 22.

text.p: - All Mexican ports were open Thursday, Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1500 GMT daily meteorological report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.

Light rains expected later in the day along Baja California peninsula and much of Pacific Coast. Maximum winds of 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) and waves three to five feet high.
Rains and strong winds along coasts of Tamaulipas, Tabasco, Veracruz and the Yucatan peninsula. Winds the region from 10 to 15 knots and waves four to six feet high.
Hot and partly cloudy with increasingly intense rains. Winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
